description: Defines the Blob class, a container for typed pointers, used in PyTorch's ATen library for managing tensors and other data types.

classes.name: Blob
classes.description: A container class that manages a typed pointer, including ownership semantics, type checking, and access methods.

methods.name: IsType
methods.description: Checks if the stored content is of a specific type T.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Returns the meta information of the stored object.

methods.name: TypeName
methods.description: Returns a string view of the type name of the stored object.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the stored object of type T, asserting the type matches.

methods.name: GetRaw
methods.description: Returns a raw const or mutable pointer to the stored object.

methods.name: GetMutable
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the stored object, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: GetMutableOrNull
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer if the stored object is of type T, otherwise null.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Sets the stored object to a new allocated instance of type T, taking ownership.

methods.name: ShareExternal
methods.description: Shares an external pointer without taking ownership.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the Blob to an empty state, freeing owned resources.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two Blob instances.
